scenarioSnapshot.name: Shared Device Cluster
scenarioSnapshot.description: Illustrative synthetic purchases for V13 replay. MCC and channel are authored demo inputs; labels are story annotations, not measured model performance.

warnings.message: Stack-d5 combines eight frozen expert scores with prior history. Review priority is a within-upload percentile, not a fraud probability. Performance on a new source is unverified; development labels were exposed.

Retrospective review selects the highest scores within each UTC day: ceil(1% of assessed purchases), ties by stable payment ID. Small days can exceed 1% overall. Adding records can change the queue and percentiles. No alert does not establish safety. Review does not authorize or block a payment.

Only supported purchases contribute to history. Missing optional fields remain unknown. Short histories can reduce performance. Labels and device identities are excluded from scoring; merchant-fraud feedback is unavailable.

Features use strictly earlier observations; equal-time peers cannot affect each other. Date-only rows make all history use whole-day batches and omit calendar signals. Queues use the entire submitted day retrospectively.
